{{Top|leg}}
'''Red Team''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] military unit stationed at [[Eyrie Base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They once stole a [[Unidentified freighter (Eyrie Base)|freighter]] from [[Ongella]] that was later used by [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Merinda Niemeh]] to infiltrate the planet [[Hargeeva]].
